description: This file defines the MiddlewareDispatcherInterface, an interface in the Slim Framework that manages middleware stacking and request handling.

classes.name: MiddlewareDispatcherInterface
classes.description: An interface extending RequestHandlerInterface for managing middleware stack in Slim Framework.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a middleware to the stack, accepting a MiddlewareInterface, string, or callable.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a MiddlewareInterface to the middleware stack.

methods.name: seedMiddlewareStack
methods.description: Seeds the middleware stack with the inner request handler.
